notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
-Multiplayer
Added an arrow above the players head to make it easier to see each other.
Added Player name.

-Ai
Changed damage of the Spitter from 15 to 8.
Changed attack range of the Spitter from 230 to 150.
Changed the Hit box of the Spitter to make it easier to hit.

-Machines.
ReTextured the 
fuelcell mk.2,
solarpanel mk2 and 3, 
constructor, 
battery mk.2,
building tool,
storage box mk.1
workbench,
windturbine.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Character:
-Increased run speed.
-Reduced oxygen usage.
-Added a Quest log to the Inventory.

Buildings:
-Added the Vehicle bay mk1 were you can craft a hoverbike.
-Retextured the Terminal, Chemistry bench, Assembler, a small battery,
fuel cell, solar panel mk1,
Fabricator, Forge.
-Changed forge base energy usage from 0.5 to 0.3
-Changed forge crafting energy usage from 2.5 to 2
-The chemistry bench no longer needs energy.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Multiplayer
-Fixed inventory disappears when leaving and joining the same server.
-Fixed unable to hit Enemies or Resources.
-Fixed hit location off center.

Ui
-Fixed most cases where a menu would not close correctly.

Character
-Changed the time it takes for the heart rate to go down from 0.04 to 0.08(decrease value).
